# langsmith_chart_section (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith custom chart section by ID or title. Backed by `GET /api/v1/charts/section`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_chart_section" "example" {
  title = "Production Health"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the section. Either `id` or `title` must be specified.
- `title` (String) The title of the section. Either `id` or `title` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `chart_count` (Number) Number of charts in the section.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) A description of the section.
- `index` (Number) The display order index.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
